title: Erdogan: Egypt Could Join Türkiye-Saudi-Pakistan Defence Pact
detail: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan stated that Egypt could join the emerging Türkiye-Saudi Arabia-Pakistan defence pact, signalling a potential expansion of the regional security alignment. The announcement broadens the trilateral framework into a potential quad arrangement spanning North Africa, the Gulf, and South Asia.

media.caption: Erdogan signals Egypt could expand the Türkiye-Saudi-Pakistan defence pact
